definition: each chain as the closed surface that holds its own volume (0.135 nm³ for each amino acid, 0.32 nm³ for each nucleotide) in a cloud where each residue is spread as a Gaussian 1 nm wide, on a grid 1 nm apart; of a surface in pieces, its largest and every piece of at least 5% of its volume are kept, smaller ones dropped (listed under dropped)
illustration: The viewer's own surface of the entry's coordinates, an illustration: not the structure, and nothing of the entry is copied but the numbers worked out here. The Protein Data Bank states no surface.
title: cryo-EM structure of human RNA polymerase III in apo state
frame: the measuring tool's frame: origin at the centre of the whole's atoms; its own axes, longest first, each sign set so that its largest part is positive; z = x × y
